messages:
karla: Hey team — heads up I'm proposing a 2-month split this Q: homebase remains US but I'll be physically in Toronto for Jul+Aug (family reasons). Need clarity on WFH stipend proration, any payroll registration risk, and benefits impacts.

toni: thanks for flagging. if homebase stays US, stipend eligibility remains but we need a Temporary Remote Location (TRL) so payroll can pro-rate and tag.

karla: ok will submit TRL. curious about payroll nexus — 60 days in Canada, any chance Redwood needs to register or withhold locally?

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-7819 — "Canada 60d: nexus & withholding check for karla" — assigned to james. ETA 2 business days. :ticket: 

james: taking it. quick Q: will you remain on USD payroll and not open a Canadian bank account? any client meetings in Canada?

karla: yes USD payroll, no local bank, only family stuff. no customer meetings planned.

james: that lowers employer obligations. Canada can trigger employer registration for sustained presence, but 60 days is usually below thresholds. legal will confirm. please still submit TRL and we will note the lack of local compensation.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: TRL form lives in Benefits -> Location Changes. Attach flight or booking and set start/end dates.

karla: submitted TRL TL-5421 with flights and dates Jul 3 1 Aug 31.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-7819 — TL-5421 received, james added note: USD payroll, no local bank; awaiting legal.

toni: stipend proration note: WFH allowance is monthly and pro-rated by days in month. because Jul+Aug are full months you'll receive two full stipend payments only if homebase remains US for payroll purposes. If you change homebase, payments may move to local currency and be subject to local tax.

karla: good to know. any effect on health benefits / telehealth while I'm in Toronto?

james: Redwood plans provide emergency international coverage for short trips; telehealth should work but check timezone windows. Canada has excellent healthcare but routine local care is not covered. consider travel insurance if expecting non-urgent care.

toni: ops note: we cannot ship company peripherals internationally in most cases. if you need a local SIM or hotspot we can pre-authorize a one-time connection stipend up to $150 as an expense.

karla: might need a SIM. can we pre-approve the stipend so I don't have to wait until I return?

people-ops-bot: Pre-approval flow: submit a short request in the TRL attachments or reply here with reason. payroll teams can put a note for quick reimbursements.

karla: added a TRL attachment requesting a connection stipend and explaining it's for temporary SIM + data.

james: legal note: if you end up taking meetings with Canadian customers or contracting locally while there we may need to re-evaluate. please avoid client-facing engagements during the TRL period.

karla: understood — no client meetings.

payroll-bot: #PR-7819 last updated 2165008890: awaiting legal review (james).

karla: thanks all — TL-5421 submitted. ping me if you need an attestation signature or more details. :slightly_smiling_face:

toni: thanks karla, we'll follow up once legal confirms. enjoy the time with family. :maple_leaf:
